node.text:
Oh, how you shined!
To everyone who raised a light or lit up a landmark to celebrate Voyager’s Light-Day, thank you for shining bright with us.

Let's talk about Voyager 1 and 2!
Join us Nov. 19 for a status update on the twin probes and a discussion of their unique mission. Plus, we'll have a Q&A session and a sneak peek at the upcoming NASA+ Voyager documentary. go.nasa.gov/4k942pz

node.content-desc: Image: An artist's concept of the Voyager spacecraft, with its long antenna pointing down and to the right in the direction of Earth. Earth isn't visible in the image, but Voyager is among the stars. In the background, there is also a long, deep blue ribbon of gas and dust stretching from the bottom of the image to the top.
